properties.notes: Extant permission now exists. A reserved matter application has yet to be submitted for the outline element of the permision.. Hybrid full and outline application for the demolition of Rome House and Castle House and the residential redevelopment of the site (including affordable housing) within 6 No. apartment buildings and a row of terraced town houses, shared surface access, public and private open space; cycle parking and car parking spaces. Full details submitted for Phase 1 comprising 142 No. residential units within 3 No. buildings ranging in height from 3 No. to 13 No. storeys, 36 No. undercroft car parking spaces, shared surface access road and amenity space. Outline approval sought for Access, Layout and Scale of Phase 2 with matters of appearance and landscaping reserved, comprising circa 146 No. flats and 18 No. town houses with cycle parking and car parking spaces (Ref. P/2015/4089).
